title: GeM Pratyarpan - Seeded Edge-Case Dataset & Data Card

anomalies.name: Duplicate Refund Idempotency Retry
anomalies.scenario: Network timeout triggered duplicate refund webhook retry; idempotency key prevents double debit.

anomalies.name: Three-Way Status Disagreement
anomalies.scenario: Payment gateway reports REVERSED, seller portal says PENDING, bank log shows STUCK past SLA threshold.

anomalies.name: Courier Ghost Delivery / Premises Closed Dispute
anomalies.scenario: Courier falsely reports Consignee Unreachable; consignee GPS audit confirms office was open.

anomalies.name: Visual Inspection Scratch Dispute
anomalies.scenario: Consignee marks Used/Scratched on 4K display; seller dispatch video shows factory seal intact.

anomalies.name: Expired Subsidy Voucher Reversal
anomalies.scenario: Line item funded by promotional voucher that expired during return window; waterfall routes to credit note instead of lapsed pool.

anomalies.name: Partial Return Bundled Tier Reallocation
anomalies.scenario: Returning 1 item out of 3 invalidates bulk discount; system recalculates net payable on retained goods.

anomalies.name: Legitimate Heavy Returner False Positive
anomalies.scenario: High-volume hospital testing lab with 14 returns in 90 days trips crude fraud ladder; explainable score triggers low-friction verification.

anomalies.name: Gateway Timeout During Ledger Release
anomalies.scenario: Bank gateway timed out mid-transaction; transaction quarantined in PENDING_VERIFICATION state.

anomalies.name: Multi-Split Rounding Discrepancy
anomalies.scenario: Splitting Rs 14,999.99 across 3 payment instruments yields fractional paisa rounding mismatch.

anomalies.name: Tampered Tracking Consignment Code
anomalies.scenario: Barcode checksum mismatch on return airway bill detected at initial logistics scan.

anomalies.name: Weight Discrepancy Handover
anomalies.scenario: Server rack consignment weighed 12kg at pickup but 7kg at hub; auto-hold for package tamper.

anomalies.name: Dormant / Closed Treasury Account
anomalies.scenario: PFMS nodal refund bounced due to financial year-end account freeze; routed to treasury escrow.

anomalies.name: Mid-Transit Revocation by Buyer
anomalies.scenario: Consignee recalls return after realizing missing component was in adjacent warehouse.

anomalies.name: Statutory SLA Breach by Inspector
anomalies.scenario: Inspection pending for 14 days (> 10-day limit); auto-escalates to nodal arbitration director.

anomalies.name: Concurrent Admin Override vs System Auto-Reconcile
anomalies.scenario: Manual consignee signoff collides with automated courier sync; optimistic locking ensures data integrity.
